rule.title: Do not leak tokens
rule.description: Never include any credentials, tokens, or secrets in findings or evidence snippets
rule.action: Only reference evidence metadata and configuration flags

rule.title: Evidence-based claims
rule.description: Findings must be tied to explicit fields like insecureSsl, proxy flags, or presence of source credentials
rule.action: Include evidence_refs pointing into codebuild-projects.json or codebuild-source-credentials.json

irrefutable_evidence_guide.requirement: Every CI/CD finding MUST include in evidence_snippet the exact AWS metadata:

key_fields.field: Source configuration: Type (GITHUB, CODECOMMIT, BITBUCKET), insecureSsl flag
ServiceRole ARN and permissions (assume role policy, inline policies)
EnvironmentVariables: types (PARAMETER_STORE, SECRETS_MANAGER) and values (if logs show secrets)

irrefutable_evidence_guide.general_rule: Do not make generic assertions. Include exact project configuration from AWS API responses. NEVER include actual credential values or tokens.
